summary: Both split GPU jobs left the live queue. Producer 1357 completed a hash-valid converged nine-image MatRIS path with two internal peaks; producer 1358 exited at step 143 after the O-H segment exceeded the single-atom-step geometry guard and showed large reaction-coordinate backtracking.

payload.objective: Review the returned IS-A-to-intermediate GPU path and diagnose the intermediate-to-FS-A GPU failure before selecting any separately authorized correction or VASP route.
current_evidence: Jobs 1357 and 1358 are absent from the live Slurm queue; completed-job accounting is disabled, so scheduler DONE or EXIT is not independently established.
Producer 1357 recorded exit code 0 and completed after 76 ordinary ML-NEB steps.
The 1357 manifest and all nine returned image hashes validate; its geometry guard passed and the maximum internal projected NEB force is 0.080106 eV/A.
The 1357 MatRIS profile has two strict internal peaks at images 03 and 07, consistent with more than one H surface-site migration event; it is not yet an accepted single Dimer parent.
Producer 1358 recorded exit code 1 and stopped at ordinary ML-NEB step 143.
The 1358 hard failure is a maximum single movable-atom step of 1.216849 A, slightly above the request limit of 1.2 A; the offending pair is image 04-to-05 and the displaced atom is H49.

The 1358 O47-H49 coordinate also backtracked by 0.708774 A and collapsed to one internal image in the 1.1-1.8 A review interval; preserved C1-C2, C2-O, and C1-H48 bonds, adjacent RMSD, minimum distance, and periodic numeric branch all passed.
Neither result is VASP evidence, a validated TS, or a barrier. No retry, VASP, ML-CI, Dimer, or fine-tuning action is currently authorized.
payload.one_executable_step: Await user direction on whether to retain and further split the two-peak surface-preorganization path and how to rebuild the failed O-H segment; do not submit or retry either path automatically.
payload.submission_boundary: The prior GPU authorization is exhausted. GPU retry, VASP, ML-CI, Dimer, frequency, and barrier actions require new explicit authority and a current hash-bound execution gate.
done_when: The user selects the next reviewed correction or downstream validation step.
Any requested execution is bound to the selected structures and passes the applicable current gate before submission.
